Tori L.: FYI I opened a PR to change a few SDK snippets for the streaming/pagination migration. The idea is to show the new compact helpers but keep a tiny 'no-helper' example for portability: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4302
Hank G.: Link looks good. High-level: which helpers are we introducing?
Tori L.: Two helpers: `stream_resume_cursor()` (decodes/resolves resume tokens consistently) and `iter_with_backoff()` (yields items with jittered retry). We show both but mark them optional.
Maya P.: Can you paste the Python helper? I want to sanity-check async semantics.
Tori L.: Sure:
```python
# helper: async iterator with simple jittered backoff
async def iter_with_backoff(call_fn, max_retries=3, base=0.1):
    attempt = 0
    while True:
        try:
            async for item in await call_fn():
                yield item
            break
        except TransientError:
            if attempt >= max_retries: raise
            await asyncio.sleep(base * (2 ** attempt) + random.random() * base)
            attempt += 1
```
Maya P.: Looks good. Note: use small defaults in docs but call out to increase for prod.
Chris R.: For TS I'm adding a tiny Deno + Node dual example for resume token: Node uses Buffer, Deno uses atob. Also changed the streaming sample to use `response.body.getReader()` in the browser/deno bit.
Hank G.: We had a migration concern: older examples used `client.stream(req)` which returned a generator; new API returns a `ReadableStream`. Did we document how to wrap both?
Tori L.: Yes, added a short appendix: title "Migration: generator -> ReadableStream" that shows a one-liner wrapper for authors who haven't updated. Example shown: `ReadableStream.from(asyncGenerator)` (not real API, annotated as pseudo).
Maya P.: Could we instead show an explicit helper that converts generator to async iterator? Many readers will copy/paste.
Tori L.: Done. Added `gens_to_reader()` small snippet. Kept it terse.
Chris R.: Go example: I included a context-with-timeout, a retry-loop, and an explicit `resumeCursor` decode using `base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString`. Also show how to cancel mid-stream with signal handling.
Maya P.: Any link fixes? I recall one earlier thread about the pagination deep-link anchor changing.
Tori L.: Yup fixed that anchor and updated a cross-ref in the embeddings guide that pointed to the old pagination section.
